items.title: AWS Bedrock to require sharing data with Anthropic for Mythos and future models
items.summary: AWS Bedrock announced a policy change requiring a 30-day retention of traffic data for Mythos-class models like Fable 5. This retention is intended to allow Anthropic to identify misuse patterns not visible from single exchanges. The policy affects all future models of similar or higher capability levels hosted on AWS Bedrock.
items.why_it_matters: Data retention policies could impact privacy and compliance strategies for developers using AWS Bedrock for AI models.

items.title: Introducing North Mini Code: Cohere’s First Model For Developers
items.summary: Cohere launched North Mini Code, a new model aimed at developers. This model is designed to enhance coding capabilities and streamline development workflows. It provides efficient, high-performance code generation and integration capabilities, making it a valuable tool for developers seeking to leverage AI in their coding processes.

items.title: Introducing Gemma 4 12B: a unified, encoder-free multimodal model
items.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled Gemma 4 12B, a new multimodal model that operates without an encoder, offering more streamlined processing for complex tasks. This model aims to improve efficiency in handling diverse data inputs, potentially enhancing AI applications across various domains.

items.title: Migrating Your GitHub CI to Hugging Face Jobs

items.title: Can Voice Agents Handle Bilingual Customers? Benchmarking Frontier ASR on Code-Switched Speech
